subject: Issue with invoice VEN041-0020 – input tax credit
body:
Dear Titan Logistics Ltd team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found that invoice VEN041-0020 dated 12 Sep 2025 is not reported by GSTIN 06ENPAF1143N3ZK. Rs 58,480 of input tax credit is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and confirm once it appears. We will hold the credit note until then.

Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
